bootstrap.macro_policy: Fixed full-sample evaluable label set; discard a macro replicate if any label loses a class. Per-label intervals use all valid replicates.
bootstrap.uncertainty_scope: Study sampling only. No training-seed, label-error, patient-clustering or selection uncertainty; multiplicity unadjusted.

calibration.scheme: Equal-width [0,1], left closed/right open except final bin includes 1; count-weighted absolute calibration gap

threshold_note: Gold74 best-F1 and specificity-constrained thresholds are descriptive in-sample estimates; no deployment claim.

training_config.ema_policy: fp32 parameters and floating buffers; integer buffers copied
training_config.accuracy_definition: fraction of available binary finding labels correct at sigmoid >= 0.5
training_config.selection_metric: validation macro AUROC only; Gold74 never selects checkpoints

gold_definition.historical_parent_training_exclusion: Not independently re-established; historical selection may include Gold.

reused_tooling: Extended analyze_training_evidence.py in place: reused its AUROC helper (generalized missing-label masks), study-ID/label alignment, sklearn metric definitions, paired study-resampling design and training-curve approach. Fixed-label macro-bootstrap and 10-bin calibration conventions were also reviewed in the existing analyze_fusion_posttrain.py in the parent worktree. Added weighted bootstrap acceleration, caches, ablations, activation hooks and subgroup/error outputs. Inference directly reuses load_fused_checkpoint, StudyDataset/discover and bag_logits from the actual model/trainer. The legacy no-argument entry point remains import-safe.
